headlines.title: Lucid begins 'operational reset' as CEO says EV maker will delay midsize vehicle
headlines.summary: The company didn't provide updated guidance. New CEO Silvio Napoli earlier this year suspended production expectations.

headlines.title: How the 'Baby iPhone' and an Apple supplier leak explain China's recent supply chain moves
headlines.summary: In China's biggest electronics marketplace, Huaqiangbei, technicians don't have the parts to make exact copies of Apple's latest phones.

headlines.title: Pinterest shares fall on lukewarm sales guidance
headlines.summary: Pinterest reported better-than-expected earnings and revenue for the second quarter, though its forecast was online in line with estimates.

headlines.title: Stocks return to record highs. Investors who sat tight during the recent momentum crash are being rewarded.
headlines.summary: The S&P 500 booked its 25th record close of 2026, after a 42-day break.

headlines.title: Elon Musk repeatedly one-upped his execs on SpaceX’s first earnings call
headlines.summary: Musk kept inflating the already-big promises being made by SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen and Gwynne Shotwell on the company's first call.

headlines.title: Lucid’s turnaround plan hinges on $1.4B in cash savings, robotaxis
headlines.summary: Lucid's new CEO Silvio Napoli listed four must-win priorities, including the successful launch of its midsize EV, finishing a factory in Saudi Arabia, cutting expenses, and robotaxis.

headlines.title: Jim Cramer says one hedge fund's collapse cleared the way for tech's rally
headlines.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the collapse of AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness removed a major source of forced selling.

headlines.title: Upstart’s AI upgrades pay off, as a pickup in loan growth helps send the stock higher
headlines.summary: The AI lending company says it’s enhanced its model to better assess the risk of borrowers.

headlines.title: How to get the best hotel deals for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
headlines.summary: We’ve partnered with hotels around Moscone West during Disrupt, taking place October 13 to 15, to secure the best prices available for attendees.

headlines.title: AMD's revenue climbs 50% and data center sales doubled, but the stock is down
headlines.summary: AMD's data center unit is driving the company's growth, up 107% over last year.

headlines.title: Sen. Susan Collins will oppose Blanche, a critical blow for Trump's AG pick
headlines.summary: Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche needs at least 50 votes on the Senate floor to be confirmed after clearing the Senate Judiciary Committee.

headlines.title: Chipotle pulls jalapenos from some locations after salmonella investigation. Here’s what to know.
headlines.summary: While Chipotle’s stock slid on Tuesday, it said health investigators had “no ongoing concerns” with the chain after it removed the jalapenos.

strategies.ma20_cross_ma60: 20 日均線高於 60 日均線時持有，否則空手。
strategies.buy_and_hold: 買入持有基準，用於比較策略是否優於單純持有。

assumptions.transaction_cost_note: 每次部位變化扣除 0.1% 交易成本，用於保守估計。
assumptions.lookahead_bias_control: 策略使用前一交易日訊號承擔下一交易日報酬，避免偷看未來資料。

signals.disclaimer: 研究訊號僅供分析，不是買賣建議。
